Class GamesManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.GamesManager
public class GamesManager extends Object
Manages multiple concurrent Mesos game instances on the server. Routes incoming NetworkRequests to the correct GameController by resolving the requesting player's username. Handles game lifecycle (creation, join, termination) and player disconnections. All internal data structures are thread-safe.
